card.title: IPad Mini 2 No Touch

claims.statement: iPad mini 2 touch FPC is very easy to damage; check it and its diode readings first.
Missing PP5V25_GRAPE points to PMIC U8100; missing PP1V8_GRAPE points to U1700; otherwise the touch controller is inside the CPU, so a CPU reball is the last step.

procedure: Try a new digitizer; inspect touch FPC.
Replace U8100 or U1700 as indicated; reball CPU last.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
